data.label: SaaS Cloud Platform 2.0 – Architecture, AI Engine & Global Launch
data.description: End-to-end engineering, security, and go-to-market roadmap for launching SaaS Cloud Platform 2.0. Covers multi-tenant cloud infrastructure, RBAC, core APIs, Design System 2.0, AI automation, usage-based billing, and global rollout. Duration: 20.11.2026 – 19.02.2027.

dna.problem: Legacy monolithic architecture cannot support multi-tenant enterprise isolation, custom AI workflows, or usage-based monetization at scale.
dna.solution: Next-generation distributed SaaS platform featuring multi-region Kubernetes, PostgreSQL RLS, real-time WebSocket sync, BYOK AI Copilot, and automated Stripe billing.
dna.targetAudience: High-growth B2B software engineering teams, product managers, and enterprise organizations requiring secure, compliant cloud collaboration.
dna.marketLandscape: Fast-paced B2B SaaS ecosystem demanding sub-200ms API response times, 99.99% SLA availability, and enterprise SSO/SOC 2 compliance.
dna.businessModel: Multi-tier SaaS subscription (Free, Developer, Pro, Enterprise) combined with metered consumption billing for API calls, storage, and AI tokens.
dna.gtmStrategy: Zero-signup interactive playground, design-partner private beta, developer-first documentation/SDKs, and high-visibility Product Hunt/HN launch blitz.
dna.team: Alex (Lead Cloud Architect & Strategy Lead), Beth (Principal Fullstack & Security Engineer).
